_comment: Repository coverage policy: 100% with no exclusions.
'floor' is the enforced ratchet - CI fails below it. Raise it as tests land;
never lower it. 'target' is the policy itself and does not move.
Baseline recorded 2026-09-07, the first honest measurement of this repo.
Before the test-shims/vscode package existed, only 41 of 265 source files were
reachable from tests and Bun reported 99.64% - an average over 15% of the
codebase, with the entire VS Code integration layer invisible rather than
These figures are WEIGHTED (hit lines / total lines), not the unweighted mean
of per-file percentages that Bun's text reporter prints. Bun's mean reads ~19
points higher here because the repo has many small fully-covered parsers and a
few large uncovered command files. Weighted is the number that cannot be gamed
by adding another tiny well-tested file.
branchNote: Bun's lcov reporter emits no BRDA/BRF/BRH records, so branch coverage is not measurable under bun test. Reaching the branch half of the policy needs a runner change (vitest + istanbul).
